terminal/screen#

Moving the cursor, clearing and the alternate screen; following resizes.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

session.use_alternate_screen(true);
session.clear(ClearRegion.screen);
session.move(row: 1, column: 1);
let sizes = TerminalResizes(session);
let size = await sizes.size();               // the next size change

Description#

Moving the cursor, clearing and the alternate screen; following resizes.
